Decision D9 · P3 · Daniela

Old 'infer admission status from dictation' code is still in the repo (AC5 says remove it); the survey says 'Round Companion' while the ticket says 'RoundAI'

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-06/S18

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S27 Survey copy as specified: baseline questions and options, Settings feedback text (T6 only)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T6 Survey questions, answer options and copy are exactly as specified (baseline 6 questions and buckets; handoff follow-up question; … (TFA-94609 AC 1; TFA-94609 Spec 1; TFA-94609 Spec 2; TFA-94609 Spec 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician (make-session) with the baseline unanswered, so the card shows on the Hospital list

When Open the baseline survey from the card and read every question and option; close it without submitting. Open Settings and read the Feedback section

Then Baseline: the six Spec 1 questions and the bucket options. Feedback: 'How is RoundAI working for you? Your answers go to the pilot team. Please don't include patient details.', a 1-5 rating, 'What should change?', 'Send feedback'. The handoff follow-up question (Spec 2) is checked on screen in S07 and S08

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94609 AC 1 / Spec 1 / Spec 3 (T6, gated: a miss reports as Blocked, which is why it has its own scenario and masks no ungated requirement). Product name: 'Before RoundAI' and 'How is RoundAI working for you?' are knownGaps 'open: Q11' (main shows 'Round Companion', SettingsModal.tsx:285), so the difference shows in the report as a known gap, not as a silent pass

Where it ran: local code-review (judged by reading the code); test method STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-94609 ready for pr

The survey copy matches the spec except the product name: the app says 'Round Companion' where TFA-94609 says 'RoundAI' ('Before RoundAI…', 'How is RoundAI working for you?').

Evidence: allure f5280aec-…-result.json; code-review lane, status known-gap. 12/12 Spec 1 / Spec 3 strings are present at e02167f, and B2 and F1 differ only in the name (SettingsModal.tsx:285). The matrix knownGaps mark this 'open: Q11'. T6 is gated on TFA-94609 (ready for pr, PR #86), so a miss would report as Blocked. Note: TFA-94513 AC 2 requires the sign-in screen to say 'Round Companion' (not 'RoundAI').

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane code-review.

Test method: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: code-review.
